source: ChemSep v8.3 pure component data (Copyright (c) Harry Kooijman and Ross Taylor; Artistic License 2.0), as embedded in DWSIM 10.2.5 (DWSIM.Thermodynamics.dll resource chemsep1.xml), compound "Carbon monoxide" (ChemSep index 908, CAS 630-08-0). Molecular weight, normal boiling point, Tc, Pc and acentric factor as given; standard liquid density: the saturated liquid at Tr = 0.7 (eq. 105, at the eq. 101 vapour pressure), because Tc lies below 288.7 K and no 60 F liquid exists; ideal-gas Cp eq. 16 (A=29100, B=-1979.753, C=10.58274, D=-0.0000790406, E=-1.99685e-7; data 10..1500 K) fitted by least squares as shifted_polynomial_5 over 68.15..900 K (35 points), largest deviation 0.036 % at 119.9 K, 0.017 % over 298.15..900 K; viscosity tables and freezing data in their entries. Imported by tools/compound-import.

fluid_domain.evidence: Fluid network only (not the column range): the ideal-gas Cp fit range, from max(ChemSep Cp data start, triple point) to 900 K; below it Cp is held and integrated, with a notice (a data-range end, never a validity floor). 100 Pa..2000000 Pa as the bundled light ends: PR78 from ChemSep critical constants, not qualified above that.

thermochemistry.source: Ideal-gas heat of formation at 298.15 K and formula CO (molar mass 28.01 g/mol) of ChemSep v8.3 pure component data (Copyright (c) Harry Kooijman and Ross Taylor; Artistic License 2.0), as embedded in DWSIM 10.2.5 (DWSIM.Thermodynamics.dll resource chemsep1.xml), compound "Carbon monoxide" (ChemSep index 908, CAS 630-08-0). Heats of reaction follow by Hess's law. Data only.

flammability.source: NIOSH Pocket Guide to Chemical Hazards, Carbon monoxide (npgd0105, https://www.cdc.gov/niosh/npg/npgd0105.html, read 2026-11-05): LEL and UEL in air. CDC material, in the public domain. Constant with temperature (owner decision E23).

combustion.source: Hess's law on this record's thermochemistry (chemsep-8.3-hf-r1): the formula burnt to CO2, H2O (gas), SO2 and N2 on the ideal-gas heats of formation at 298.15 K of icheme:chemsep_carbon_dioxide (chemsep-8.3-hf-r1), icheme:water (chemsep-8.3-hf-r1) and icheme:chemsep_sulfur_dioxide (chemsep-8.3-hf-r1). Computed by tools/heating-values/heating-values.mjs. Read by a fired heater's burners.

Data for the pairs derived from group counts.

henry_in_water.source: IAPWS G7-04, Guideline on the Henry's Constant and Vapor-Liquid Distribution Constant for Gases in H2O and D2O at High Temperatures (2004), after R. Fernandez-Prini, J. L. Alvarez, A. H. Harvey, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 32 (2003) 903, table of A, B, C for CO in H2O: ln(kH/p*) = A/Tr + B tau^0.355/Tr + C Tr^-0.41 exp(tau), Tr = T/647.096 K, tau = 1 - Tr, p* the saturation pressure of water, kH on the mole-fraction basis. Coefficients as in Table 2 of the guideline (iapws.org, read 2026-11-11). Copyright 2004 IAPWS; publication in whole or in part is allowed provided attribution is given to IAPWS.
